The main takeaway from our work is that
the MAC protocol should not be designed as a black box, but rather as a set of components that can be tuned according to application requirements.
the MAC protocol for volcano monitoring should take into account the specificities of the application, and should not be a generic protocol that tries to achieve the best of both worlds.
